extensions.title: Add-ons
extensions.text: Software without a device of its own for the whole band, e.g. speech output, announcements or stem separation - devices are under Stage gear. Installed add-ons apply on every tablet and the Stage server; disabled ones disappear from the widget library.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.text: So that StageBoard can control a device (amp, mixer, looper, MIDI). Normally invisible: “New device” in Stage gear installs the matching one, and removing the last device offers to remove it. Here for troubleshooting only.

test.title: Test plug-ins
test.text: Stand-ins that only log what they receive - a mixer, light or backup that doesn't exist. For trying things out only; they can only be installed in the dev app.

ann.title: Announcements - settings
ann.beforePartInfo: What is said in the bars before a part, one field per beat. Tap to change.
ann.countInInfo: What is said in the count-in bars before bar 1; “Name” here is the part on bar 1 (intro). If a song has fewer count-in bars, the later part applies.
ann.numbersInfo: What is said for a beat's number. Empty = the digit, which every voice reads in its language. For a dialect, write it the way it should sound (“zwaa”).
ann.textsInfo: What is said for a song part, for every song of the band. Empty = the name as it is in the song.
ann.noParts: The songs have no parts yet ({{part}}, {{chorus}}).
ann.previewInfo: Plays on this device with click: two count-in bars, the intro and the chosen part on bar 5.
ann.failed: Could not be played - check the Stage server and the speech output plug-in.
ann.switchInfo: “Chorus”, “Bridge” … a bar before the part, over the same output as the click - only on the device that plays the click.

voice.title: Speech output - voice
voice.intro: With this voice every device announces the song parts. A voice is loaded onto the Stage server once (internet needed, best at home), after that everything works offline.
voice.noPiper: Piper is not installed on the Stage server (docs/21 §9.1).
voice.noCatalog: Voice list unreachable - Stage server offline. Only the voices already loaded are shown.
voice.subtitle: {{language}} · quality {{quality}} · {{size}}
voice.cantPlay: Could not be played - is the voice loaded and the Stage server reachable?
voice.finetuned: · fine-tuned from {{base}} (its licence may apply too)
